events.verdict: Allen (BKN) makes marginal contact to the body of Vucevic (ORL) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Vucevic (ORL) cleanly dislodges the basketball away from Allen (BKN) in the post.
RLB shows during the loose ball, Fournier (ORL) briefly grabs Carroll's (BKN) jersey.
Augustin (ORL) is issued a Delay of Game Violation for shooting the basketball and not following the request by the official for the ball following the whistle.
Vucevic (ORL) goes to and through Harris (BKN) who establishes his position on this drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Allen (BKN) is firming up and makes marginal contact with Augustin (ORL) during the pick.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] LLB shows Allen (BKN) touched the ball while it is in the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Allen (BKN) is firming up into a legal picking position and makes incidental leg to leg contact with Fournier (ORL) as he absorbs the contact.
Vucevic (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt by Carroll (BKN).
Graham (BKN) briefly engages with Fournier (ORL) prior to the inbound pass.
Vucevic (ORL) establishes himself in a screening position and makes incidental arm contact with Graham (BKN).
Carroll (BKN) makes incidental contact to the arm of Vucevic (ORL) during his shooting motion that does not affect his shot attempt.
Harris (BKN) dislodges Ross (ORL) from his position during the loose ball.
Bamba (ORL) commits a take foul on Dinwiddie (BKN).
Isaac (ORL) commits a take foul on Kurucs (BKN).
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Vucevic (ORL) enters the lane and fails to clear prior to the release of the free throw attempt from Kurucs (BKN).
Allen (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Fournier (ORL) drive.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court of an Offensive Goaltending is confirmed.
Fournier (ORL) commits a take foul on Russell (BKN).
